items.text: Livestock leads now break at 15 m (up from 7 m) and animal UI shows familiarity and gender by default.

Motorcycle dismount order fixed, improving exit behavior and item safety.
Sail wind mechanics corrected, restoring expected sailing performance.
New underwear customization category added and eyebrows category removed, with an updated character creator layout.

2026-10-05.summary:
### Animals & Farming
- Livestock leads now break at 15 m (up from 7 m) and animal UI shows familiarity and gender by default.
- Selling a bought or found animal to the livestock vendor now incurs a higher penalty (0.2 → 0.85).

### Vehicle & Sailing
- Motorcycle dismount order fixed, improving exit behavior and item safety.
- Sail wind mechanics corrected, restoring expected sailing performance.

### Character Customization
- New underwear customization category added and eyebrows category removed, with an updated character creator layout.

items.text: Fixed death screen on first softcore join; players now spawn directly at the beach.
Research tables can now be used to research Animal Fence and Gate.
Milk can be stacked when the skim timer is under 1 minute, and skimming works even if food spoiling is disabled.
Scrap helicopter dismount points adjusted to avoid always ejecting players from the front.

2026-10-04.summary:
### Softcore Mode
- Fixed death screen on first softcore join; players now spawn directly at the beach.

### Research & Crafting
- Research tables can now be used to research Animal Fence and Gate.

### Farming & Food
- Milk can be stacked when the skim timer is under 1 minute, and skimming works even if food spoiling is disabled.

### Vehicles
- Scrap helicopter dismount points adjusted to avoid always ejecting players from the front.

2026-10-03.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.
